caption: The drawing depicts two objects positioned vertically in the center of a plain, off-white background. The upper object is an oval-shaped brooch or pin with a gold-colored border. Inside the oval is a black background featuring a white flower with five petals, a yellow central core, two green leaves, and a green stem. Below this object, there is a horizontally oriented bar pin with a gold or bronze tone, depicted with its clasp and pin visible. The word "ACTUAL SIZE" is printed in small, uppercase black letters centered beneath the bar pin. There are no other objects or designs on the background.
title: Brooch
